work.title: Pet projects

99node.title: 99node
99node.lede: A roadmap builder where depth is a drill-down into a node rather than an infinite canvas. Budgets and schedules are aggregated over the whole subtree on every read, so editing a leaf cannot leave a stale number on an ancestor. Published maps are served with SSR and no session.

qurbaqa.title: Qurbaqa
qurbaqa.lede: A modular life tracker: money, food, sport, goals, health. You connect only the modules you need and the app, its menu and its assistant context assemble around them. Multi-currency is built on rates the user sets and the period freezes, never a market rate substituted behind their back.

99node.title: 99node
99node.lede: A roadmap builder. You lay out a map for a topic - "Python Programmer", "A holiday in Thailand" - then drill into any step and build a sub-roadmap inside it, to any depth. A map can be published to a catalogue and read without an account.
99node.differentiator: What separates it from a mind map is depth rather than canvas size. There is no single infinite sheet: every node is a plane of its own with local coordinates.

shots.alt: The public catalogue of published roadmaps, with search, tag filter and sort.
shots.p: Published maps are readable with no account. Each card already carries the totals rolled up from the whole map - here 63 500 baht over 88 steps and 15 days.

shots.alt: A published roadmap: a grid of day cards, each with its own budget and date.
shots.p: Every step shows how many steps are nested inside it and the budget summed from its entire subtree - 8 480 on day one, 11 350 on day two.

shots.alt: Inside a step: breadcrumbs, the step's own budget and date, and the steps nested within it.
shots.p: The step becomes a plane of its own, with breadcrumbs back up. The 8 480 above is exactly these children added up - nothing is stored on the parent.

qurbaqa.title: Qurbaqa
qurbaqa.lede: A personal life tracker: money, food, sport, goals and health in one place. The product mechanic is modules - you connect only the sections you need, and the app assembles around them, menu and assistant context included. On top of that sits light gamification: a pixel-art frog called Pilar, a pond that grows with every connected module, streaks, levels and XP.
qurbaqa.differentiator: A monorepo of four applications sharing one API, plus a pixel-art UI kit of my own, pixkit, published to npm from CI and used by both the React and the React Native clients.

99node.title: 99node
99node.lede: Конструктор роадмапов. Пользователь строит карту по теме - «Python Programmer», «Отпуск в Таиланде», - проваливается внутрь любого шага и строит под-роадмап на любую глубину. Карту можно опубликовать в каталог и читать без регистрации.

qurbaqa.title: Qurbaqa
